The 2001 Canadian Grand Prix (round 8, Circuit Gilles Villeneuve, 10 June 2001) was won by Ralf Schumacher driving for Williams. He started from 2nd on the grid. Michael Schumacher (Ferrari) finished second and Mika Häkkinen (McLaren) third.

ANSWER: Ralf Schumacher
